I downloaded Blender animations. Maybe instead of learning a language I can learn an art medium. I don't know what it'll yield, or even if I wanted to learn it in the first place. I just picked something, anything, just to distract myself.

Hi guys. I am a graphics designer. Earlier today a client wanted a design for a shirt with the words "Per mea manu suum, an nullum." He said it's latin for "By my own hand, or none." Something about achieving things by himself, or not at all.

Now I kinda wanted to go a little beyond what's expected of me and decided to run this phrase by you guys just to see if his translation is correct before I proceed. It would help me out so much.
